subject: SF Cloud Summit - Sponsorship package and speaking slot negotiations
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura@cloudworks-events.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: SF Cloud Summit - sponsorship opportunity and initial package

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Attached is the SF Cloud Summit 2025 media kit (SFCloud_MediaKit_v3.pdf) with the two lead sponsorship packages we discussed: Platinum (lead booth, 30-min mainstage session, logo on stage backdrop) and Gold (small booth, sponsor theatre 15-min slot, logo on site map).

Quick summary of what Platinum includes:
- Mainstage speaking slot (30 mins) during Day 2 keynote track
- Large 10x20 exhibitor island, corner placement
- Logo on main stage backdrop and all program materials
- 1,000 marketing-qualified lead shares (GDPR/consent-compliant)
- Four full-conference passes, four expo-only passes

Standard Platinum rate is $95,000. We do offer one startup/scale discount off list for new category entrants. Myself and John (cc'd) can work through specifics if you have ask(s) on deliverables or pricing.

If you're interested, can you confirm the package you'd like us to draft a contract for and any non-standard asks (speaker AV, additional signage, booth orientation)? Happy to set up another call.

Best,
Laura Chen
Senior Partnerships Manager
CloudWorks Events
laura@cloudworks-events.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: SFCloud_MediaKit_v3.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SF Cloud Summit - sponsorship opportunity and initial package

Marissa / Rachel — forwarding the media kit from CloudWorks. They quoted Platinum at $95k; we spoke about trying to secure mainstage time but want clearer guarantees for logo placement and session title + bio control.

Key asks we should push for:
- Guarantee the 30-min mainstage slot to be in the AI/Inference track (not vendor general session)
- Lead delivery SLA (format, timing, field mappings) and opt-in proof
- Logo on stage backdrop + premium placement in attendee guide (front of guide)
- Ability to provide a custom event handout (single-sheet) in attendee bags
- Two comp sessions for our engineering leads to run demos in sponsor theatre

Also consider requesting a 20% discounted rate in exchange for an exclusive inference-focused content pillar and an onsite customer panel. If you both agree, I'd like to propose a counter that swaps large booth corner for a slightly smaller island but secures session placement and lead SLA.

Thoughts? I can draft a reply to Laura and ask for updated contract language and a sample lead delivery CSV.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

On Thu, Nov 20, 2025 at 11:02 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Rachel — forwarding the media kit from CloudWorks. They quoted Platinum at $95k; we spoke about trying to secure mainstage time but want clearer guarantees for logo placement and session title + bio control.
> 
> Key asks we should push for:
> - Guarantee the 30-min mainstage slot to be in the AI/Inference track (not vendor general session)
> - Lead delivery SLA (format, timing, field mappings) and opt-in proof
> - Logo on stage backdrop + premium placement in attendee guide (front of guide)
> - Ability to provide a custom event handout (single-sheet) in attendee bags
> - Two comp sessions for our engineering leads to run demos in sponsor theatre

Agree with all of the above. A couple of additional negotiation points from the sales side:
- Ask for a 45-minute mainstage instead of 30 if we commit to Platinum (adds value for messaging)
- Insist on exclusivity within the inference/LLM category for the mainstage session (no direct competitors in same slot)
- Request access to a pre-show attendee list (hashed email + company + title) 48 hours before show for targeted outreach (we'll sign an NDA if needed)

If they won't bud on price, propose the following counter: $80k for Platinum-lite (30-min slot, medium booth 10x15, guaranteed logo on backdrop and front of guide, 750 lead shares) + two sponsor-theatre sessions. That nets lower spend but preserves visibility.

I'll draft suggested language and Vanessa can review before we send.

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura@cloudworks-events.com>, John Simms <john.simms@cloudworks-events.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SF Cloud Summit - sponsorship opportunity and initial package

Laura / John — thanks for the kit. We reviewed with our field team and have a few points we hope you can incorporate if you’ll draft an updated agreement: 

1) Speaking slot: We'd like the 30-minute mainstage slot to be scheduled in the AI/Inference track (Day 2). If you can offer a 45-minute mainstage instead for Platinum, we'd consider that an upgrade. Also ask that the session listing be editable by Redwood for title and speaker bio through contract.

2) Logo placement: Confirmed logo placement on main stage backdrop plus premium placement in the attendee guide (front third). We also request inclusion in the digital sponsor carousel (homepage and app).

3) Lead delivery: 750–1,000 qualified leads (GDPR-compliant) for Platinum; deliverable as CSV with: email (hashed if required), company, title, opt-in status. Delivery cadence: 50% within 72 hours after session, remaining within 14 days. Please include a sample schema.

4) Booth / collateral: We'll accept a 10x15 island (non-corner) in exchange for session guarantees. We request the ability to insert one 1-sheet handout into attendee bags, and a floor decal at the booth entrance (if allowed).

5) Price: Our target net spend is $80,000 for a Platinum-like package with the above deliverables and two sponsor-theatre slots (15-min each). Alternatively, full Platinum at $95,000 if you can provide a 45-minute mainstage and exclusivity within the inference track.

6) Pre-show access: Pre-show hashed attendee list 48 hours before the event for targeted outreach (NDA acceptable).

Attached is a short counter proposal PDF (Redwood_Sponsor_Counter.pdf) that summarizes the asks. If you can send back an updated SOW/contract and sample lead CSV schema, we can sign and provide PO. Happy to jump on a call if helpful.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Field Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_Sponsor_Counter.pdf
From: John Simms <john.simms@cloudworks-events.com>

Cc: Laura Chen <laura@cloudworks-events.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SF Cloud Summit - sponsorship opportunity and initial package

Thanks Vanessa — received and appreciate the specificity. We can accommodate most of your asks; a few quick notes: 
- We can confirm the AI/Inference track placement and will include exclusivity language for direct inference competitors for that slot.
- 45-minute mainstage can be approved for Platinum if the agreement is executed by Dec 6 (limited number of extended slots).
- We can provide a pre-show hashed attendee list 48 hours prior under NDA.
- Lead delivery SLA: we will deliver 60% within 72 hours and remainder within 10 business days; we'll include a sample CSV schema in the SOW.
- Regarding price: we can do $80,000 for the Platinum-lite option you outlined (10x15 island, 30-min mainstage, guaranteed logo placement, 750 leads, two sponsor-theatre sessions). If you'd prefer the 45-minute upgraded slot and exclusivity, price remains $95,000 and we need to confirm contract by Dec 6.

I'll have Laura send over an updated SOW and sample schema tomorrow, and include the initial booth map snippet (booth_layout_highlevel.png). Expect a DocuSign link for the Platinum-lite SOW if you confirm $80k.
